intent_ru: Исследовать точное обратное упорядочение в сообщённом субъективном суждении о времени событий (условный «разворот на 180°»), сохраняя физические события, их уникальные идентификаторы и независимые отметки времени неизменными.

definition.operational_180: For externally anchored A->B->C, a participant-style *reported temporal judgment* C->B->A, not a literal 180° physical rotation nor a direct observation of consciousness.
definition.physical_chronology: Immutable UTC aware event timestamps, event_id and per-event distinct source roots
definition.reported_order: Self-report/temporal judgment stored as reported refs; different from reverse retelling and reverse stimulus presentation
definition.related_non180: cyclic rotation, local adjacent swap, same-content ambiguity, unstable or absent clocks, planned future event
definition.same_content_distinct_event: Matching content_signature is not physical event identity; unique independently corroborated event IDs distinguish synthetic episodes
definition.time_labels: Calendar TODAY/YESTERDAY computed independently from reference date and Europe/Kyiv timezone and never modify UTC event

baselines: naive reversal detector ignoring report modality
primary_metrics: Exact label match with synthetic gold
synthetic_experiment.acceptance: 0 false 180 labels by conservative rule, all synthetic gold contracts deterministic, 29 tests PASS. No learned-model gain claim.

research_boundaries: Reported reverse-order judgment is not direct proof of reverse phenomenological time flow.
Reversing narration or playback does not imply reversed first-person experience.
Reversal of relative ordering does not cause physical earlier events to occur later.
Any physical witness provenance cannot be proven independent by a fabricated source root string.
Clock discrepancies, duplicate witnesses or unknown event IDs require abstention.
Planned future cannot be mistaken for observed event; no time-travel claim.
No clinical diagnosis, real subjects, patient data or modification of any production weights.
